fact: Le360 lists Togo among countries where Starlink is announced as available from 2026 but no licence has been granted; the article's date is used as the date.

Techs.tg says Togo does not yet officially have Starlink service; some individuals and firms use imported equipment without official authorisation, and ISOC-Togo began negotiations with Starlink in March 2024. Article date used.
Agence Ecofin says Starlink service is still not available in Togo, which Starlink had shown as planned for 2025 and now lists for 2026, subject to approval by public authorities. Article date used.

TechnoMag lists Togo among 19 countries where Starlink is 'Scheduled for 2026', not among the 26 where it is active; the service is not yet on sale in Togo (article dated 2026-06-29, no date given for the status itself).
